_comment: Demo fixture using Khronos Group's public Avocado glTF sample. Replace model.src with author-provided geometry for production.
title: Identify parts of an avocado
prompt: Click the seed (pit) at the centre of the fruit.

hotspots.label: Skin (exocarp)
hotspots.feedback: That is the skin (exocarp). The pit is at the centre.

hotspots.label: Flesh (mesocarp)
hotspots.feedback: That is the flesh (mesocarp). The pit is at the centre.

hotspots.label: Seed / pit (endocarp + seed coat)
hotspots.feedback: Correct — the pit is the single large seed at the centre of the fruit.
